mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over the 20-day horizon despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers a compression of discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2% for the full period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and strong demand, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS down 1% and GDPC1 up 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the combined FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 surge.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), elevated discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in a tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC > 0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth above 4% signals robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding 4% growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth rate above 4% triggers a surge in corporate investment and consumer spending, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 remaining above 4% for the full period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% combined with rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4% and PAYEMS rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 (from 100 baseline) indicates robust supply chain activity, reducing production bottlenecks and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO rising above 105.0.
